### To be removed when PR is created
**:memo: IMPORTANT: Please do not create a Pull Request without creating an issue first.**
- _Any changes needs to be discussed before proceeding, failure to do so may result in the rejection of the pull request._
- _Go throw [Pull request guidelines](./../docs/guidelines/pull-request-guidelines.md) if you are not aware of them._

## Feature Summary
- Provide an overview of the feature and its purpose.

## Implementation Details
- Describe the approach taken for this feature.
- List any major decisions or trade-offs made during development.

## Screenshots / GIFs (if applicable)
- Include screenshots or GIFs to illustrate how the feature looks and works.

## Testing Instructions
1. Explain how to test this feature.
2. Describe expected results and edge cases to check for.

## Documentation
- [ ] Documentation has been added or updated.
- [ ] All necessary code comments are included.

## Closing issues
- Link any relevant issues here (e.g., `Closes #123`).
<!-- Put closes #XXXX in your comment to auto-close the issue that your PR fixes (if such). -->
